theorem.joint_law: (H,X) jointly Gaussian with means mu_H,mu_X and covariance blocks Sigma_HH,Sigma_HX,Sigma_XX
theorem.bound: P_W(X>=t) <= exp(-theta.(t-mu_X)+0.5 theta^T Sigma_XX theta)* E_{N(mu_H+Sigma_HX theta,Sigma_HH)}[W]/ E_{N(mu_H,Sigma_HH)}[W], theta>=0
proof: Exponential tilting of a joint Gaussian shifts the full mean by Cov((H,X),X)theta and leaves covariance unchanged.
The H marginal therefore shifts by Sigma_HX theta.
Divide by the unshifted Palm normalizer E[W].
